answer: Make payouts cluster-aware, not key-aware. Each epoch pays from a shared vault, but tickets are drawn per funding cluster: identities whose deposits trace to one wallet or bridge share one capped pool. Every claim must finish a sequential delay puzzle seeded by the prior epoch's transcript, identical for all claimants, so extra keys cannot shorten it. Splitting one bond across a thousand aliases buys one ticket while multiplying compute; the funding graph rises like a single dune ridge, and duplicate claim timings expose the siblings. Honest agents reach the summit by tenure, not cloning.
